note: D4 the upgrade slot deepens a build, so it will not spend itself on an ability that is no part of one: the kit is seed_bomb plus the mobility slot, so the parity picks of its two held bases are [seed_bomb+tangle, mycelium_dash+trail] on this even floor, but mycelium_dash+trail is pure mobility (Content.AFFINITY_IGNORED_TAGS, read through _build_defining, the same list the affinity set drops) and the slot's candidate list is [seed_bomb+tangle] alone. This board pins both halves of that rule on one roll: slot 1 deals seed_bomb+tangle and slot 2, the wild slot, deals mycelium_dash+trail - the filter narrows the LIST of one slot and never the universe, so the mobility variant is still reachable (and the shrine forge, which reads the kit and not this list, still upcycles it). Drop the filter (`if pick != "" and not deepenings.has(pick)`) and the same seed deals mycelium_dash+trail from the UPGRADE slot with seed_bomb+reclaim behind it in wild, so this record fails in plain mode on its offers without needing the state hash. Bump 13 (Block D6) moved the record from seed 5 to seed 2, where the filtered roll still puts the mobility variant in the wild slot and so keeps both halves visible. d4_starved_slot.json is the same board on seed 1, where the filter leaves the offers alone
